_readme: One written job post per role. `match` lists the role titles (as recruiters type them, case-insensitive) this post is used for. Live numbers come from the MR sheet; only the words come from here. RULE: 'lookingFor' is skills, experience, education and licences only - never age, sex, height, looks or civil status (RA 10911, and it keeps every post fair). Add a role here when the sync's 'needs copy' list names it.

roles.title: Sales Promoter
roles.summary: Represent a brand on the store floor: help shoppers find the right product, demonstrate it, and turn interest into sales.
responsibilities: Engage shoppers, explain product features and recommend the right fit
Keep displays stocked, tidy and correctly priced
Track daily sales and stock and report them to your coordinator
Run in-store promotions and product demos
lookingFor: At least high school graduate
Confident talking to customers
Retail, sales or promo experience is an advantage
Willing to work retail shifts, weekends and holidays

roles.title: Brand Ambassador
roles.summary: Be the face of a brand in store: build product awareness, engage customers and help drive sales.
responsibilities: Introduce and demonstrate products to shoppers
Support campaigns, sampling and in-store events
Keep the brand area presentable and well stocked
Report sales, feedback and competitor activity
lookingFor: At least high school graduate
Friendly, outgoing and well spoken
Sales or promo experience is an advantage
Willing to work weekends and holidays

roles.title: Sales Associate
roles.summary: Help customers in store, from finding the right product to the checkout, and keep the shop floor running smoothly.
responsibilities: Assist and advise customers on products
Handle sales transactions accurately
Restock shelves and keep the store tidy
Help with stock counts and deliveries
lookingFor: At least high school graduate
Good communication and customer service skills
Retail experience is an advantage
Willing to work shifts, weekends and holidays

roles.title: Fragrance Consultant
roles.summary: Guide shoppers to the right fragrance at beauty and personal-care counters, and help the counter hit its sales targets.
responsibilities: Recommend fragrances based on each customer's preference
Meet daily and monthly sales targets
Maintain counter stock, testers and displays
Submit sales and inventory reports
lookingFor: At least high school graduate, with complete pre-employment requirements
Warm, confident and customer-focused
Beauty, fragrance or retail sales experience is an advantage
Willing to start as soon as possible

roles.title: Sales Account Specialist
roles.summary: Grow sales in your area by building strong relationships with distributors, dealers and retail accounts.
responsibilities: Visit and manage distributor, dealer and retail accounts in your territory
Take orders and follow up on deliveries and collections
Find new accounts and grow existing ones
Report sales, market feedback and competitor activity
lookingFor: Sales experience, ideally in pet food, feeds, poultry supply, animal health or general trade
Proven relationships with distributors and dealers in your area
Self-driven and comfortable working in the field
Good negotiation and communication skills

roles.title: Operations Assistant
roles.summary: Support the sales and operations team behind the scenes: orders, records and coordination with accounts in the field.
responsibilities: Process orders and keep account records up to date
Coordinate with field sales, distributors and the warehouse
Prepare simple reports and track deliveries
Handle documents and day-to-day admin tasks
lookingFor: At least college level
Organised, accurate and good with spreadsheets
Experience in sales operations or distribution is an advantage
Clear communicator, comfortable on the phone

roles.title: Warehouse Staff
roles.summary: Keep goods moving through the warehouse: pick, pack, sort and prepare orders accurately and on time.
responsibilities: Pick, pack and sort items accurately
Prepare orders for dispatch, including labelling and sealing
Check items for quality and report discrepancies
Keep the work area clean, organised and safe
lookingFor: At least high school graduate, with complete pre-employment requirements
Able to do physical work and stand for long periods
Warehouse experience is an advantage
Willing to work shifts

roles.title: Dispatch Checker
roles.summary: Make sure every shipment that leaves or arrives is complete, correct and properly recorded.
responsibilities: Check incoming and outgoing shipments against receipts and invoices
Verify product quantity, quality and condition
Record items accurately in the inventory system
Report discrepancies, damages or missing items
lookingFor: At least high school graduate
Careful, detail-oriented and good with numbers
Warehouse or logistics experience is an advantage
Willing to work shifts

roles.title: Warehouse Admin
roles.summary: Keep the warehouse's paperwork and stock records accurate so operations run without surprises.
responsibilities: Encode receipts, issuances and stock movements
Reconcile inventory counts with system records
Prepare warehouse reports and documents
Coordinate with dispatch, receiving and logistics teams
lookingFor: At least college level
Good with spreadsheets and record-keeping
Warehouse or inventory admin experience is an advantage
Organised and accurate

roles.title: Delivery Driver
roles.summary: Deliver goods to customers and businesses safely and on time, and represent the company at every drop-off.
responsibilities: Drive and deliver items safely and on schedule
Check orders before and after delivery
Help load and unload the vehicle
Keep delivery documents complete and accurate
lookingFor: Valid professional driver's license with the right restriction code for the vehicle
Good knowledge of local routes
Driving or delivery experience is an advantage
At least high school graduate, with complete pre-employment requirements

roles.title: Delivery Helper
roles.summary: Work alongside our drivers to load, secure and deliver goods safely and on time.
responsibilities: Load, unload and secure cargo
Help check deliveries against documents
Assist customers at drop-off points
Keep the vehicle and cargo area organised
lookingFor: At least high school graduate
Able to do physical work
Delivery or warehouse experience is an advantage
Reliable and willing to work early or long shifts

roles.title: Construction Laborer
roles.summary: Support skilled trades on a construction site: moving materials, preparing work areas and keeping the site safe.
responsibilities: Carry and prepare materials and tools
Assist carpenters, masons, steelmen and electricians
Keep the site clean, organised and safe
Follow safety rules and supervisor instructions
lookingFor: Able to do heavy physical work outdoors
Construction experience is an advantage
Willing to be deployed to the project site
Follows safety procedures

roles.title: Carpenter
roles.summary: Build, install and repair formworks and wooden structures on construction projects.
responsibilities: Build and install formworks, frames and fixtures
Read plans and take accurate measurements
Use and maintain carpentry hand and power tools
Follow safety standards on site
lookingFor: Proven carpentry experience; TESDA NC II is an advantage
Can read plans and measurements
Willing to be deployed to the project site
Follows safety procedures

roles.title: Mason
roles.summary: Lay blocks, plaster and finish concrete work to specification on construction projects.
responsibilities: Lay hollow blocks and bricks to line and level
Mix and apply mortar, plaster and concrete
Read plans and set out work accurately
Keep tools and the work area safe and clean
lookingFor: Proven masonry experience; TESDA NC II is an advantage
Can read plans and measurements
Willing to be deployed to the project site
Follows safety procedures

roles.title: Steelman
roles.summary: Cut, bend and tie reinforcing steel to plan for concrete structures.
responsibilities: Cut, bend and install rebar to specification
Tie and secure reinforcement before concrete pours
Read structural plans and bar schedules
Follow safety standards on site
lookingFor: Proven experience as a steelman or rebar worker
Can read structural plans
Willing to be deployed to the project site
Follows safety procedures

roles.title: Electrician (NC II)
roles.summary: Install, test and maintain electrical systems on construction projects to code.
responsibilities: Install wiring, panels, lighting and fixtures
Test and troubleshoot electrical systems
Read electrical plans and follow the electrical code
Keep tools and work areas safe
lookingFor: TESDA NC II in Electrical Installation and Maintenance
Proven electrical work experience
Can read electrical plans
Willing to be deployed to the project site

roles.title: Electrician Helper
roles.summary: Assist licensed electricians with installation work while building your own skills on site.
responsibilities: Prepare tools, cables and materials
Assist with pulling wire, mounting boxes and fixtures
Keep the work area clean and safe
Follow instructions from the electrician and foreman
lookingFor: Basic knowledge of electrical work
Electrical or construction experience is an advantage
Willing to learn and be deployed to the project site
Follows safety procedures

roles.title: Electrical Foreman
roles.summary: Lead the electrical crew on site: plan the work, supervise quality and keep the job safe and on schedule.
responsibilities: Plan and assign daily electrical work
Supervise installation quality and compliance with the code
Coordinate with engineers and other trades
Enforce site safety and report progress
lookingFor: Several years of electrical work, with supervisory experience
Can read and interpret electrical plans
TESDA NC II or higher is an advantage
Willing to be deployed to the project site

roles.title: Civil Foreman (Bridge Works)
roles.summary: Lead civil works crews on site, with experience in bridge construction.
responsibilities: Plan and supervise daily civil works
Ensure work follows plans, specifications and quality standards
Coordinate manpower, materials and equipment
Enforce site safety and report progress
lookingFor: Experience as a civil works foreman, including bridge works
Can read structural and civil plans
Strong leadership of site crews
Willing to be deployed to the project site

roles.title: General Mechanic
roles.summary: Keep project vehicles and equipment running: inspect, service and repair them on site.
responsibilities: Inspect, service and repair vehicles and equipment
Diagnose mechanical faults
Keep maintenance records
Follow safety and workshop procedures

Knowledge of engines and heavy equipment is an advantage
TESDA NC II is an advantage

roles.summary: Operate a bulldozer safely for earthworks and site preparation on construction projects.
responsibilities: Operate the bulldozer for clearing, grading and earthmoving
Do daily pre-operation checks and basic maintenance
Follow plans and the site engineer's instructions
Work safely around people and other equipment
lookingFor: TESDA NC II in Heavy Equipment Operation (Bulldozer)
Proven bulldozer operating experience
Safety-conscious
Willing to be deployed to the project site

roles.title: Plumber
roles.summary: Install, maintain and repair water, drainage and plumbing systems.
responsibilities: Install and repair pipes, fixtures and fittings
Find and fix leaks and blockages
Read plumbing plans
Keep tools and work areas safe and clean
lookingFor: Proven plumbing experience; TESDA NC II is an advantage
Can read plumbing plans
Able to do physical work
Follows safety procedures

roles.title: Maintenance Staff
roles.summary: Keep the facility and its equipment in good working order through routine checks and repairs.
responsibilities: Do routine inspections and preventive maintenance
Carry out basic electrical, plumbing and carpentry repairs
Report issues that need a specialist
Keep tools and maintenance records in order
lookingFor: Maintenance or general repair experience
Basic electrical, plumbing or carpentry skills
TESDA NC II is an advantage
Willing to work shifts

roles.title: Utility Staff
roles.summary: Keep the site and its facilities clean, safe and in good condition.
responsibilities: Clean and maintain work areas, equipment and facilities
Do minor repairs and report bigger issues
Help move materials and set up areas
Follow safety and housekeeping standards
lookingFor: At least high school graduate
Able to do physical work
Housekeeping or maintenance experience is an advantage
Reliable and willing to work shifts

roles.title: Appliance Service Technician
roles.summary: Install, test and repair home appliances and electronics as part of an after-sales service team.
responsibilities: Install, test and repair appliances and electronic equipment
Diagnose faults using the right tools
Explain repairs and proper use to customers
Keep service reports accurate

Experience with refrigeration, laundry or audio-visual appliances is an advantage
TESDA NC II is an advantage
Good with customers

roles.title: Service Technician Helper
roles.summary: Assist our after-sales technicians as they install, maintain and repair equipment at customer sites.
responsibilities: Prepare tools, parts and materials for each job
Assist with installation, maintenance and repair work
Keep the work area clean and safe
Help record completed work and parts used
lookingFor: At least high school graduate
Basic technical or mechanical skills
Technical-vocational training is an advantage
Willing to learn and travel to customer sites

roles.title: Production Staff
roles.summary: Work on a manufacturing line: operate equipment, assemble and pack products, and help the line hit its quality and output targets.
responsibilities: Operate production equipment as trained
Assemble, inspect and pack products
Follow quality and safety procedures
Keep the workstation clean and organised
lookingFor: At least high school graduate
Able to stand and do physical work for a full shift
Production or factory experience is an advantage
Willing to work rotating shifts

roles.title: FTTH Designer
roles.summary: Design fiber-to-the-home networks: survey routes and produce accurate network designs for build teams.

Coordinate with project and build teams
Keep design records and documentation up to date

Familiar with design and mapping tools such as AutoCAD or GIS
Engineering or technical background is an advantage
Willing to be assigned to a provincial area

roles.summary: Lead a team of FTTH designers and make sure network designs are accurate and delivered on time.
responsibilities: Supervise and review the work of FTTH designers
Check designs against standards and project requirements
Coordinate with project managers and build teams

Engineering or technical background

Willing to be assigned to a provincial area

Coordinate with project and legal teams

Track site acquisition and permit progress

roles.summary: Find and screen the right people for our clients' manpower requests, from sourcing to endorsement.
responsibilities: Source candidates through job boards, referrals and job fairs
Screen, interview and assess applicants
Endorse qualified candidates and follow up
Keep the applicant pool and records up to date

Recruitment experience, ideally high-volume

Organised and able to handle several requests at once

Track hiring metrics and report to management

Experience with high-volume or multi-site hiring
Strong leadership and communication skills

roles.title: HR Specialist

responsibilities: Maintain employee records and 201 files
Handle onboarding and employee concerns
Support HR policies and compliance
Prepare HR reports
lookingFor: Graduate of Psychology, HR or a related course
HR generalist experience
Knowledge of Philippine labor law
Organised and discreet

roles.title: HR Compensation & Benefits Specialist
roles.summary: Make sure every employee is paid correctly and gets the benefits they're entitled to.
responsibilities: Process payroll inputs and benefits
Handle SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions and claims
Answer employee pay and benefits questions
Keep compensation records accurate and compliant
lookingFor: Graduate of HR, Accounting or a related course
Experience in payroll or compensation and benefits
Knowledge of Philippine statutory benefits
Accurate and good with numbers

roles.title: Accounting Specialist

responsibilities: Record and reconcile financial transactions
Prepare billing, payables and receivables
Support month-end closing and reports
Keep financial documents organised
lookingFor: Graduate of Accountancy or a related course
Accounting or bookkeeping experience
Good with spreadsheets and accounting systems
Accurate and detail-oriented

roles.title: Admin Coordinator
roles.summary: Keep an office or account running smoothly: coordination, records and day-to-day admin.
responsibilities: Coordinate schedules, requests and documents
Maintain records and prepare simple reports
Act as a point of contact for staff and clients
Handle supplies and general admin tasks
lookingFor: At least college level
Organised and good with spreadsheets
Admin or coordination experience is an advantage
Clear communicator

roles.title: Security Officer
roles.summary: Keep people, property and premises safe through patrols, access control and incident response.
responsibilities: Control access and check visitors, vehicles and deliveries
Patrol the premises and report incidents
Respond to alarms and emergencies
Keep the security logbook up to date
lookingFor: Valid security guard license
Security experience is an advantage
Alert, responsible and calm under pressure
Willing to work shifts
